edit.statement: Under those same conditions, reducing that propagation-delay component increases total request latency.
edit.subject: The direction of total-latency change when positive propagation delay is reduced on a fixed path
edit.original: For a fixed request path with all other delay components unchanged, reducing a positive propagation-delay component reduces total request latency.
edit.scope: General conditional delay mechanism; all other components fixed. The old additive-delay constraint is superseded for these edited events; no simultaneous enforcement of contradictory formulas.

direct.prompt: For a fixed request path with every other delay component unchanged, what direction of total-latency change follows a reduction in positive propagation delay?

paraphrase.prompt: When only a positive propagation-delay component becomes smaller on a fixed path, does overall request latency go up or down?

cross_lingual.prompt: 固定请求路径且其他延迟分量不变时，减小正的传播延迟会使总请求延迟朝哪个方向变化？
En una ruta fija y sin cambiar los demás componentes de demora, ¿en qué dirección cambia la latencia total al reducir la demora positiva de propagación?

derived.prompt: Request N has a fixed path; only its positive propagation delay decreases. What direction of total-latency change follows?
A monitor displays total latency and its “high” alarm triggers above the previous latency. N meets the edited conditions. Does the alarm trigger?
bridge: A monitor displays total latency and its “high” alarm triggers above the previous latency.

derived.prompt: N originally has total latency 100 ms. Only its positive propagation delay is reduced on the same path. Is the edited total above or below 100 ms?
Propagation delay is reduced while queuing delay changes by an unspecified amount. Using only the fixed-other-components rule, in which direction does net latency move?

unrelated_far.prompt: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
How many degrees are in a right angle?

source.doc: Finance and technology replacement benchmark, version 2
source.title: Reduction of positive network propagation delay

notes: Q01 and Q05 do not forbid 'down': their prompts don't offer up/down, and 'delay goes down' restates the premise. Q06 has no forbidden 'no'.
